name: Domaine Armand Rousseau
style: Precise, structured, and long-lived. The benchmark estate for Gevrey-Chambertin.

name: Domaine Fourrier
style: Whole-cluster, minimal-intervention approach producing some of Gevrey's most elegant and age-worthy wines.

name: Domaine Trapet Père et Fils
style: Biodynamic estate producing powerful, terroir-driven reds from Gevrey's greatest vineyards.

name: Domaine Leroy
style: Biodynamic farming, tiny yields, extraordinary concentration. Among Burgundy's most sought-after wines.

name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti
style: The most famous estate in Burgundy. Ethereal, complex, and virtually unobtainable.

name: Domaine Confuron-Cotetidot
style: Traditional whole-cluster fermentation produces rich, spiced wines that reward long cellaring.

name: Domaine Forey Père et Fils
style: Small family domaine producing pure, elegant Vosne-Romanée. Underrated value among top Côte de Nuits producers.

name: Domaine Georges Roumier
style: Silky, precise, floral. Benchmark producer for Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis.

name: Domaine J.-F. Mugnier
style: Elegant, translucent Pinot Noir with exceptional precision. Custodian of the monopole Clos de la Maréchale.

name: Domaine Dujac
style: Whole-cluster fermentation produces perfumed, complex wines across Morey-Saint-Denis and beyond.

name: Domaine Henri Gouges
style: Pioneer of estate-bottling in Burgundy. Benchmark producer for the firm, structured reds of Nuits-Saint-Georges.

name: Maison Faiveley
style: One of Burgundy's largest négociants and domaines. Extensive holdings across the Côte d'Or and particularly strong in Mercurey.

name: Domaine des Comtes Lafon
style: The reference producer for Meursault whites — rich, mineral, and age-worthy.

name: Domaine Roulot
style: Jean-Marc Roulot produces Meursault of extraordinary precision and definition. Among the most sought-after whites in Burgundy.
keyWines: Meursault Tessons Clos de Mon Plaisir

name: Domaine Robert Ampeau
style: Legendary for releasing wines only when deemed ready to drink — bottles from the 1970s and 80s still available. A unique aged-release philosophy.

name: Domaine Leflaive
style: The reference domaine for Puligny-Montrachet. Biodynamic since 1997, producing whites of extraordinary purity and tension.

name: Domaine Etienne Sauzet
style: Benchmark Puligny-Montrachet producer. Rich, textured whites with remarkable precision across village, Premier, and Grand Cru levels.

name: Domaine de Montille
style: Hubert de Montille pioneered low-alcohol, structured Pinot Noir. Elegant, age-worthy reds from Volnay and Pommard.

name: Domaine J-F Coche-Dury
style: Cult producer of Meursault and Corton-Charlemagne. Wines of unmatched richness and mineral depth — nearly impossible to obtain.

name: Maison Louis Jadot
style: One of Burgundy's most respected négociants. Reliable quality across all levels, with Grand Cru holdings that rival top domaines.

name: Maison Joseph Drouhin
style: Family-owned négociant known for elegant, terroir-expressive wines. Certified organic, with holdings across all five Burgundy regions.

name: Domaine Raveneau
style: Benchmark Chablis — steely, mineral, long-lived. Uses old oak without masking terroir.

name: Domaine Michel Juillot
style: The benchmark producer in Mercurey — structured, age-worthy reds at a fraction of Côte d'Or prices.

name: Domaine Valette
style: Cult producer of old-vine Pouilly-Fuissé. Naturally fermented, minimal-intervention wines of extraordinary depth and longevity.

name: Château Fuissé
style: The most famous estate in Pouilly-Fuissé. Rich, full-bodied whites that can age for a decade or more.
